title: BoundPanelResponse
description: 201 response body of POST /api/panels/bound (HEL-364) — every id created (or reused) by the call, plus the created, already-bound panel. The pipeline run is synchronous, so `panel`'s bound DataType already has rows (GET /api/types/:dataTypeId/rows returns them immediately, no separate run call needed).

sourceId.description: The DataSource id — freshly created for an inline `source`, or the caller-supplied `sourceDataSourceId` echoed back when reusing an existing source.

dataTypeId.description: The pipeline's output DataType id — the same id injected into panel.config.dataTypeId.
